What happened after Mom closed the door. 🚪🌙

Every night, Mom prayed over Anna and closed the door. And every night, Anna heard it. At five, she whispered, "Jesus…" At nine, after a hard day, Mom prayed that the worry wasn't hers to carry. 🙏

At thirteen, headphones in, back to the door. But she still heard. At seventeen, the moving boxes were packed. 📦

That night, after closing the door, Mom stopped in the hallway… and heard Anna praying for HER: "And tomorrow, she'll be okay…" 🥹 Mom cried in the hallway. All those years, Mom prayed over her, and she never knew Anna was praying back.

"Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God." Isaiah 41:10 (ESV) 🙏 God said them first, and Jesus proved them at the cross.

Every prayer you pray over your child, you're teaching them to pray too. ❤️ And sometimes what keeps them awake is worry.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
